index: Consumer price index, total population, price reference period 2023 (average 2023 = 100), Central Bureau of Statistics Curaçao
note: The World Bank's 2021 level is in Netherlands Antillean guilders; the Caribbean guilder replaced the guilder on 31 March 2025 at one for one, so the level stands in Caribbean guilders unchanged.

sources.title: Central Bureau of Statistics Curaçao, Monthly consumer price index and inflation rates for Curaçao since 1970 (linked from cbs.cw/inflationprices)

sources.title: Curaçao Chronicle, Launch of Caribbean guilder on March 31, 2025 (quoting the Centrale Bank van Curaçao en Sint Maarten, whose site answers with a Cloudflare challenge)
sources.said: the new currency will change from ANG to XCG. "The change in the currency unit will not affect its value, 1 ANG will remain equal to 1 XCG," stated CBCS.
